name: war-gods
text: war-gods is a MacKillop cross-reference pointing to the canonical battle_gods headword. The MacKillop entry directs readers to the wider survey of Celtic war deities. The battle gods survey gathers Badb, Macha, and the Mórrígan as the chief Irish war-figures.
